name: A Ghost in Your Ear
description: When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.

name: Joie Bianco Trio
description: Joie Bianco is a 24-year-old jazz singer, teacher, and arranger from Staten Island, New York. She is known for her sweet yet warm tone, reminiscent of jazz greats like Ella Fitzgerald and Dinah Washington. Joie draws inspiration from across the musical spectrum, from the elegance of Nat King Cole and the swing of Roy Eldridge to the spirit of Sister Rosetta Tharpe and the soul of James Brown. A graduate of the University of Miamis Frost School of Music, Bianco has collaborated with many jazz luminaries, including Marilyn Maye, Jane Monheit, Cyrille Aime, and Joey Calderazzo. Additionally, she has worked with other respected New York musicians like Emmet Cohen, Bryan Carter, Peter Bernstein, Benny Benack III, and more.She has appeared in many of NYCs renowned jazz and cabaret clubs, including Jazz at Lincoln Center, Carnegie Hall, Birdland, and The Django. Joie has also performed at various venues across Texas, such as Monks Jazz, Jazz Texas, and Parker Jazz Club. While Joie loves performing solo, she can often be found singing around the city with her vocal trio, The Sunhouse Singers. This versatile groupfeaturing jazz vocalists Kate Kortum, June Cavlan, and Joie Biancohas performed at venues such as Birdland, Chris Jazz Caf, Zinc Bar, Mezzrow, Smalls, and The Django, and will appear at Jazz at Lincoln Centers Appel Room this January alongside Ekep Nkwelle and Luther Allison. Joies accolades include winning the 2019 YoungArts award in jazz vocals and the 2023 DownBeat Student Music Award for Best Solo Jazz Vocalist. Described by The New York Times Stephen Holden as a prodigious discovery, she is steadily carving out her place as a young voice in New Yorks jazz scene.
